title: Fixed Narrow Shoe and Bellows Leg Rammer
description: One newly authored complete fixed upright-rammer-style exterior. A narrow thick grounded shoe with a raised front lip supports a full inset mounting block, short lower leg and one continuous tall corrugated boot exterior. A proud collar joins that leg to a broad offset upper drive-housing appearance, with an entire upper tank-shaped cover and blank cap. Independent complete side covers and a rear blank control belong to the same machine. One continuous wraparound handle rises from two body roots around an actual empty upper rear space and carries a broad transverse grip. The whole high boot/upper machine over a narrow foot differs from the broad low plate compactor and from the long T-grip breaker with a narrow end rod; no old model geometry imported. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and centred ground datum, one prop zero scenes. Static illustrative equipment only: no fuel, spring internals, vibration, reciprocation, impact, soil compaction, handling guidance, engine or control function, stability, manufacture or safety claim. Rigging animation interaction not made.
